pages.title: Preservation Science
pages.text: Any raw meat plus OreSpawn $(item)Salt$() cures into $(item)Salted Jerky$() — trail food that never spoils.

pages.title: A Warning Label
pages.text: Rub a $(item)Uranium Nugget$() into the jerky and it becomes $(item)Irradiated Jerky$(): you will glow, you will regenerate, and you will not ask follow-up questions.$(p)The recipe book calls this cuisine. The Geiger counter calls it a snack that answers back.
